Choose the reaction conditions

Three stakeholders, with data from your stage 2 work. Share out your votes between what they care about, say how far you trust the data behind each, and see which reaction conditions come out on top.

1 · Your group’s results

Each stage 2 app sends its results with Send results to stage 3. Load them with your group code, or use the ones saved on this computer.

2 · Vote

Share out your votes between the nine criteria: the more votes, the more a criterion matters (none: it doesn’t count). Then set how confident you are in the data behind each one, from what the data shows under its slider. A criterion you trust half as much counts half as much; at 0% it doesn’t count at all.

3 · Recommended conditions

Every reaction in the dataset that uses one of the ligands and a metal, scored by your votes and confidence. Leave out reactions your tree predicts below % yield: a reaction that barely works is not green, whatever else it has going for it. (A tree predicts the average yield of similar reactions, so its predictions stay well below the best measured yields.)
